releaseTitle: ATalk v3.16.1 — Real-Time Delivery & Chronological Message Ordering Fix
releaseNotes:
• 01 Chronological Message Ordering: Fixed out-of-order message display by adding epoch millisecond timestamps (`timestampEpochMs`) to message bubbles and implementing automatic chronological insertion in the chat room.
• 02 Message Sync & Delivery Fix: Fixed Supabase database function column ambiguity (`column reference 'conversation_id' is ambiguous`) across `get_conversation_messages_v2`, `get_conversation_messages_delta`, and `send_message_direct`, restoring 100% reliable instant message sending and receiving.
• 03 Public Room Delivery: Enabled direct messaging and reading for the general public conversation without requiring pre-existing room membership.
• 04 Realtime Sync & Offline Cache: Cached messages and periodic delta synchronization now sort strictly by timestamp upon hydration, pull-to-refresh, and live socket arrival.
• 05 Security Audit Implementation: Retained all PBKDF2 cryptographic vault hashing, lockout defenses, network security config, and BOLA prevention from v3.16.0.
